title: My Take | Verdict finds what any parent knows: social media is designed to be addictive | South China Morning Post
summary: A jury in Los Angeles awarded a 20-year-old woman $6 million for mental health issues caused by excessive use of YouTube and Instagram during childhood, marking a significant legal precedent against social media companies. This case reflects global concerns over the impact of screen time on children's well-being.
sentiment_reason: The verdict highlights the negative impact of social media on children's mental health and sets a precedent that could lead to increased legal and financial consequences for social media companies.
